description: Bounded readiness preflight for Georgia DECAL's public Provider Data Export contract and data dictionary.
retry: No retries, redirects, alternate hosts, export POST, CSV body, provider detail request, or record acquisition.
checkpoint: The official page, its current same-origin application bundle, and the exact reviewed dictionary are validated; the export endpoint is never called.
idempotency: Each observation uses a unique UUID directory and exclusive-create artifacts.
cancellation: Abort is checked before each request, during every bounded body read, and before publication.
retention_profile: Contract metadata, application-contract hashes, and dictionary hash only; zero provider rows, addresses, contacts, ZIP observations, or coordinates.
